{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, underperforming at market peaks and over-optimistic at bottoms",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive correlates with near-term price consolidation before continuation",
    "When price is in an uptrend, model forecasts consistently trail actual prices, showing delayed reaction",
    "Sentiment negativity (below 0) precedes price bottoming and model forecasts which are too high",
    "Price momentum accelerates when sentiment becomes strongly positive, causing model to under-forecast",
    "Model mean reversion to historical ranges is insufficient - prices exhibit more volatility than forecasted",
    "Sentiment mixed/neutral conditions show highest forecast error as model cannot capture transitional dynamics"
] }
